title: Freshteam Review (2026)
intro: Freshteam is evaluated here as HR, workforce & training software — Freshteam is Freshworks' HR software for applicant tracking, onboarding, time off, and employee records. Published Growth plan free up to 50 employees; Pro/Enterprise paid tiers (2026-08-19). IMPORTANT: Freshworks announced Freshteam sunset — renewals stopped around March 2026 with migration paths to Freshservice for Business Teams. Onboarded for affiliate inventory completeness; verify live status before purchase. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s HR methodology (ease of use, hiring/workforce fit, workflow depth, integrations, mobile/frontline, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Only consider Freshteam if you are an existing customer managing migration — not for net-new HRIS selection.
verdict: Only consider Freshteam if you are an existing customer managing migration — not for net-new HRIS selection. Compare Workable, BambooHR, or Breezy HR for live ATS/HRIS peers. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.
